ai_summary: **Executive Summary: DEE Development Engineers Limited - August 2026 Order Update**  DEE Development Engineers Limited reported a robust and growing order book, increasing to INR 2,435.61 Crores as of August 31, 2026, reflecting strong year-to-date order inflows of INR 955.46 Crores. A material positive impact stems from the power division, which continues to supply electricity at a significantly higher tariff of ₹7.47 per unit due to a High Court stay, effectively preventing a revenue reduction previously ordered by the regulatory commission. While this provides immediate revenue stability, ongoing legal appeals regarding tariff revisions for both power entities introduce future regulatory uncertainty.
